content.subject: Electrical wiring safety and planning for homes
content.youtube_description:
Discover the critical importance of proper electrical wiring planning for your home's safety. This video reveals how common mistakes, like overcrowding PVC conduits with too many multi-coloured wires, can lead to dangerous short circuits, electrical fires, and unexpected shocks, even in high-value homes.

By planning adequate provisions and ensuring proper spacing within junction boxes and conduits, we prevent hazards and ensure a reliable, long-lasting electrical system. Our approach guarantees better performance for all your lighting and appliances, offering complete peace of mind.
